prompt: how to change a flat tire

plan.title: How to Change a Flat Tire Safely
plan.description: A fast guide to changing a flat tire: park safely, loosen the nuts, lift the car, swap the wheel and tighten up. Learn the one mistake that makes it harder than it should be.

beats.narration: A flat tire is not an emergency, if you do things in the right order. Start by getting safe. Park on flat, firm ground.

props.text: Flat tire? Safety first, then the wheel.

beats.narration: Set the parking brake and turn on your hazard lights. Then loosen the lug nuts a little, while the wheel is still on the ground.
Now jack the car up at the lifting point. Remove the nuts, pull off the flat, and mount the spare. Hand-tighten the nuts.
Lower the car, then tighten the nuts in a star pattern. Loosen first, lift second, tighten last. That is the whole trick.

props.text: Loosen first. Lift second. Tighten last.
